spec_cite: docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §4.4 (validation table: unknown proto3 fields ignored)
description: An unknown field alongside a valid body is ignored under the standard evolution rule: the Subscribe inside is processed normally.
preconditions: Field 15 sits in the unassigned part of band 1–15; a future revision may assign it.

steps.note: Unknown field encoded BEFORE the known one; field order does not matter.

assertions: The unknown field is ignored; the known oneof case (subscribe) drives behavior — the request is answered normally with SubscribeResponse(OK) + current configuration.
Contrast with control.unknown-oneof-case-401: an unknown field alone leaves body unset (401); alongside a known case it is simply ignored.
